items.hook: A Desolation Called Peace is a 2021 space opera science fiction novel by Arkady Martine.
items.body: It is the sequel to A Memory Called Empire, and the second novel in Martine's Teixcalaan series. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.

items.hook: The Space Ship Under The Apple Tree is a children's science fiction book series by Louis Slobodkin, and also the name of the first book of the series.
items.body: The books were published by Macmillan. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: The Odyssey becomes Christopher Nolan’s highest grossing film as it passes $1.1bn at box office
items.body:
The film-maker’s take on Homer’s epic has beaten his previous record holder The Dark Knight Rises

The Odyssey has become the highest grossing film of Christopher Nolan’s career, having made more than US$1bn at the global box office

items.hook: Wildlife is a 2018 American drama film directed and co-produced by Paul Dano, in his directorial debut, from a screenplay by Dano and Zoe Kazan, based on the 1990 novel by Richard Ford.
items.body: It stars Carey Mulligan, Jake Gyllenhaal, Ed Oxenbould, and Bill Camp. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: The Birth of Venus: A Novel is a 2003 novel by Sarah Dunant, a bestselling British author.
items.body: The story is set in the late 15th century in Florence, Italy. One of those things you can't un-know.
